entries.29ac652d3f15f648: The company wholesales products such as equipment and supplies used by researchers and engineers to scientific equipment dealers. It mainly uses a catalog sales format, providing product information through paper catalogs, WEB sites and other means and selling to users through dealers. In China, the consolidated subsidiary Yasuwang (Shanghai) Shangmao Co., Ltd. sells scientific equipment for research and other products, Nikko Hansen Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells plastic containers for scientific experiments and other products, AS ONE INTERNATIONAL, INC. mainly exports North American products to Japan and other countries, and Custom Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells electronic measuring instruments and related products.
entries.30fd601212cbac89: A specialized trading company that delivers scientific instruments, equipment and consumables used in research, industrial and medical settings to researchers and medical professionals through distributors.
entries.59533491b9481b7a: The consolidated subsidiary Triumph Nijuichi Co., Ltd. provides purchasing agency services and other services through a WEB system, and receives system usage fees from the end users and others who take part in the system. Segment information is omitted because of its low materiality.
entries.5a0a18b2c096dbcd: This is the Group's main business. As a specialized trading company handling scientific equipment, fixtures and similar items used in various laboratories, research institutions, production facilities, medical facilities and other sites, it sells equipment, fixtures, consumables and other items on a wholesale basis. This is the only reportable segment. The operation of the logistics warehouses for both divisions is outsourced to the consolidated subsidiary Iuchi Logistics Co., Ltd.
